name: Tally_Party_Sync
summary: Syncs party ledger data from Tally Prime to Google Sheets with multi-company support
description: Automated workflow that reads party (ledger) master data from Tally Prime for multiple companies and syncs it to Google Sheets. Supports test mode, smart diffing, and preserves manual edits.
author: BizAnalyzt

requires: Tally Prime with HTTP Gateway enabled

flows.description: Main workflow for syncing Tally party ledgers to Google Sheets
